recheck.summary: First Responders Credit Union / Lynn Firemen's Federal Credit Union

fields.announced_figures: Two branches, in Dorchester and Lynn; all employees retained
fields.next_steps: Regulatory approval, then member votes at Lynn Firemen's and First Responders
fields.notes: Added Nov 21, 2026 (missed at announcement). First Responders CU is the former Boston Firefighters CU (renamed June 2026). The release (CCUA copy) and Banker & Tradesman (Oct 13, 2026) give an anticipated effective date of March 2027; the March 2026 in the copy checked earlier was a typo. Members of both credit unions vote, Lynn Firemen's first; vote dates are to be set after regulators' preliminary approval. The Mass. Division of Banks lists the application as pending (comment period ended Oct 30, 2026).

recheck.summary: Unity Financial Credit Union / GHA Federal Credit Union

fields.next_steps: Connecticut Department of Banking approval of the merger application (filed Oct 5, 2026)
fields.notes: Added 2026-11-26 (missed at announcement). First public record is the CT Department of Banking's Bulletin 3269 (week ending Oct 16, 2026): Unity Financial CU and GHA FCU filed an application on Oct 5, 2026 under Sec. 36a-468a for the merger of GHA FCU with and into Unity Financial CU, with a proposed target date of Apr 30, 2027. No announcement from either credit union found yet, and GHA's member vote is not yet on NCUA's proposed-merger list. Unity Financial (formerly Health Care Financial FCU, hcffcu.org) is in New Haven; GHA FCU is in Greenwich.

recheck.summary: On Tap Credit Union / Sky Federal Credit Union

fields.notes: Joint member site names Tracie Wilcox CEO and Daisy Romo President (CEO succession) of the combined CU. On Tap's member site (checked Nov 22, 2026) says NCUA has approved the merger to go to a Sky member vote, held Jan 11 to Feb 24, 2027, and that the merger is expected to take effect May 1, 2027; On Tap members don't vote. Sky becomes a division under On Tap's charter, HQ Golden, CO. No branch closures planned.
fields.next_steps: Sky FCU member vote (Jan 11 to Feb 24, 2027) and remaining regulatory and legal requirements

fields.next_steps: Regulatory approval and a Scott CU member vote

recheck.summary: Streator Onized Credit Union / ANCO Community Credit Union

fields.notes: On NCUA's proposed-merger list (ANCO member vote Dec 9, 2026; docket NCUA-2026-2113, posted Oct 14, 2026). Announced in a joint SOCU/ANCO release dated Sep 25, 2026, posted on ANCO's website. SOCU keeps ANCO's La Salle location, which ANCO CEO Wanda Bunzell will continue to manage. Credit Union Daily (Oct 7, 2026) describes ANCO as struggling with capital.
fields.next_steps: ANCO member vote (Dec 9, 2026) and regulatory approval

recheck.summary: Sierra Central Credit Union / First U.S. Community Credit Union

recheck.summary: Nutmeg State Financial Credit Union / New Haven Teachers Federal Credit Union

fields.partner: New Haven Teachers Federal Credit Union
fields.notes: Announced date is Nutmeg's application to the CT Dept. of Banking, which approved the merger Jul 29. Expected to close in December. Nutmeg has converted to a federal charter: NCUA now lists it as Nutmeg State FCU (charter 24998). New Haven Teachers' member vote was Nov 17, 2026; result not yet published. New Haven Teachers keeps its name until systems combine (expected December 2026), and its 90 Hamilton Street branch closes on the effective date.
fields.next_steps: New Haven Teachers member approval (vote held Nov 17, 2026; result not yet published)

recheck.summary: Baxter Credit Union / HealthCare Associates Credit Union

fields.notes: Announced Jun 1, 2026 in BCU and HACU releases; on NCUA's proposed-merger list. HACU will continue under its own name as "HealthCare Associates Credit Union, powered by BCU". Ballots were mailed Oct 16; NCUA lists the member vote for Dec 4, 2026. BCU's merger page anticipates completion on Mar 1, 2027, with the member account transition likely in January 2027. Eligible HACU members get a special member dividend. BCU CEO Mike Valentine plans to retire in early 2027; Jim Block became BCU president Jul 1, 2026.
fields.footprint: IL, PR, MN, CA, GA, AR, FL, IN, MA, MS, NC, OH, UT, VA, WI
fields.next_steps: Regulatory approval and a HACU member vote (ballots mailed Oct 16; vote Dec 4, 2026)

recheck.summary: LOC Credit Union / Advantage One Credit Union

fields.notes: Advantage One members approved Jul 15. The merger's effective date and systems integration are scheduled for May 1, 2027, when LOC changes its name to Advantage One Credit Union (HQ stays in Farmington). LOC CEO Stephen Grech stays CEO and Advantage One CEO Chris Corkery becomes president, succeeding Grech as CEO when he retires.
fields.next_steps: Effective date and systems integration, scheduled for May 1, 2027 (subject to required regulatory approvals)

recheck.summary: Team One Credit Union / CASE Credit Union

fields.notes: Regulatory approval received; CASE members approved the merger (voting ended at an Oct 20, 2026 special meeting). Legal merger expected Jan 1, 2027 ("Bolder Together"), with integration through 2027. CASE CEO Jeff Benson becomes CEO and Team One CEO Derrick Barber becomes president of the combined CU. From Jan 1, 2027, CASE branches operate as "CASE Credit Union, a division of Team One Credit Union"; a new name for the combined CU is planned for later in 2027.
fields.next_steps: Legal merger, expected Jan 1, 2027

recheck.summary: Ascend Federal Credit Union / LGE Community Credit Union

fields.notes: Ascend's first out-of-state merger. Regulators approved the merger application in August 2026; LGE members approved it at a Nov 9, 2026 special meeting (voting ran Sep 22 - Nov 9). The merger becomes legally effective Jan 1, 2027, when LGE becomes a division of Ascend, operating as "LGE a Division of Ascend Federal Credit Union" until the core conversion (targeted Q1 2028). LGE CEO Chris Leggett stays in an executive role.
fields.next_steps: Legal merger on Jan 1, 2027 (all approvals received)

recheck.summary: Metro Credit Union / Members Plus Credit Union

fields.notes: Regulatory approval to proceed was granted Aug 4, 2026. Members Plus extended its member vote (set for Oct 16, 2026, per NCUA) to a Dec 14, 2026 special meeting after finding that required disclosures were not fully included in the original mailing; members were sent a corrected disclosure. If approved, the anticipated effective date is Jan 1, 2027. Metro is the continuing CU. Combined: 25 branches.
fields.next_steps: Members Plus member vote at a Dec 14, 2026 special meeting

recheck.summary: Hanscom Federal Credit Union / Alden Credit Union

fields.announced_figures: Approximately 128,000 members, roughly $2.3 billion in assets and 25 branches across Massachusetts, Maryland and Virginia
fields.next_steps: Mass. Division of Banks approval (listed as pending in its Oct 30, 2026 report), an Alden member vote at a special meeting, and resolution of MSIC's challenge
fields.notes: Added Nov 24, 2026 (missed at announcement). Announced Feb 5, 2026: Alden merges into Hanscom FCU, which keeps its name, federal charter and main office; Hanscom CEO Peter Rice leads the combined CU and Alden CEO Adam Corcoran becomes regional president. The release anticipated completion in Q4 2026, subject to regulatory approval. Alden's members have excess deposit insurance from the Massachusetts Credit Union Share Insurance Corporation (MSIC), which Hanscom doesn't carry. MSIC's board voted Sep 10, 2026 to deny the merger; Division of Banks Commissioner Mary Gallagher called that vote void, and in November MSIC sued the Division in Suffolk Superior Court to confirm its authority over mergers (Banker & Tradesman, Nov 23, 2026). No member vote date has been published.

recheck.summary: Boeing Employees Credit Union / SAFE Credit Union

fields.notes: NCUA, CA DFPI and WA DFI approved Aug 4, 2026. The member vote closed Oct 27 at a special meeting; SAFE calls the support strong but has not released a tally. In November a group of SAFE members petitioned the CA DFPI to pause and review the merger, alleging inadequate disclosure and self-dealing (Credit Union Daily, Nov 16 and 18). Checked Nov 24, 2026: SAFE's combination page and the joint BECU-SAFE site (Nov 10 update) say SAFE is still awaiting final approval from the CA DFPI; the combination has been expected to close Jan 1, 2027.
fields.next_steps: Final approval from the California DFPI; the combination is expected to close Jan 1, 2027

recheck.summary: West-Aircomm Federal Credit Union / SouthWest Communities Federal Credit Union

fields.next_steps: Legal merger, scheduled for Nov 1, 2026 (completion not yet confirmed)
fields.notes: Added Nov 22, 2026 (missed at announcement). West-Aircomm's Mar 26, 2026 release said SouthWest Communities members approved the merger. SouthWest's merger newsletter sets the effective date as Nov 1, 2026, with its Carnegie office reopening as West-Aircomm FCU on Nov 2, and swcfcu.org now redirects to West-Aircomm's site; NCUA still lists SouthWest as active, so completion is not yet confirmed. SouthWest CEO Barbara Heil retires Dec 24, 2026.

recheck.summary: Family Savings Credit Union / Liberty Bank

fields.announced_figures: A combined credit union with approximately $1.5 billion in assets, serving its markets throughout Alabama and Georgia
fields.next_steps: Regulatory approvals and approval by the shareholders of First Bancorporation of Geraldine Inc.
fields.notes: Purchase and assumption: Family Savings assumes substantially all of Liberty Bank's assets and liabilities; Liberty Bank's parent is First Bancorporation of Geraldine Inc. Price not disclosed. Liberty Bank (founded 1971) has seven offices in northeast Alabama, including Albertville, Collinsville, Crossville, Guntersville, Sardis City and Altoona. Advisers: Olden Lane and Honigman (Family Savings); Olsen Palmer and Jones Walker (Liberty Bank). Earlier in November Family Savings also agreed to buy two Citizens Bank & Trust branches (a branch-only deal, not tracked). ICBA publicly criticized the deal.
